# `embedding` operations

The exact fields each `embedding.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `embedding.embed`

`POST /v1/embedding.embed` · MCP `loom_embedding_embed` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `texts` | `list[str]` | required | The texts to embed, in order; one vector comes back per text. |
| `mode` | `Literal['query', 'batch']` | `'query'` | `query` embeds each text as a search query (whitespace-normalised, cached by text), `batch` as stored content (verbatim), the two paths an embedder offers. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `str` | The model the vectors were made with; a caller that expects another refuses them. |
| `dim` | `int` |  |
| `vectors` | `list[list[float]]` |  |

<!-- prettier-ignore-end -->
